title: Circuits of LLM Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.30076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify. However, their predictions are neither deterministic nor uniformly reliable across samples. How can we combine predictions from different models to improve reliability? We view LLM classifiers as noisy measurement instruments of an underlying target label. Our goal is to maximize average classification accuracy at a given average query cost. To this end, we introduce circuits that organize LLM classifiers into an adaptive sequence of queries and decisions. We then characterize the optimal circuit, obtain the fundamental limits of achievable accuracy, and provide practical insights on realizing the optimal circuit. Across seven classification tasks spanning safety, health, political science, human preference, agent evaluation, decision-making and reasoning, our method improves the cost-accuracy frontier over routing and cascading bas

translated_abstract: 通过简单地用待分类样本对语言模型进行提示，就能轻松构建分类器。然而，这些模型的预测既不是确定性的，也不是在所有样本上都同样可靠。我们如何组合来自不同模型的预测以提升可靠性？本文将LLM分类器视为对潜在目标标签的含噪测量仪器，目标是在给定平均查询成本下最大化平均分类准确率。为此，我们引入了“电路”的概念，将LLM分类器组织成自适应的查询与决策序列。随后我们刻画了最优电路，获得了可实现准确率的基本理论极限，并提供了实现最优电路的实用见解。在涵盖安全、健康、政治学、人类偏好、智能体评估、决策与推理的七个分类任务上，我们的方法在成本-准确率前沿上优于路由和级联基线。
tldr: 该论文将LLM分类器视为对目标标签的含噪测量仪器，提出将其组织成自适应的查询与决策“电路”，刻画了最优电路结构及准确率的理论极限，并在七个分类任务上改进了成本-准确率前沿。
